title: queue.pop raises IndexError when running a scheduled job
body:
## Steps

How to trigger it:
- With the log window open, start running a scheduled job.
- Use an input with an odd number of rows.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Environment

Lattice 3.1.6, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, server eu-west-2.

## Actual

Only the last row fails; the rest process normally. Whatever the input size, it is always the last
row that fails.

## Frequency

Reproduces on about half the runs.

## Expected

No traceback; running a scheduled job normally takes a few seconds.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:49 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:129 in run_due
lattice/sched/queue.py:84 in drain
lattice/sched/queue.py:113 in pop
IndexError: pop from empty list
